analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 35.7 entering oversold territory, showing decelerating decline from 41.7 five days ago. MACD histogram improving to -1.5822, indicating bearish convergence. Current price $272.94 is 3.4% above the 20-day low of $263.84, suggesting a potential Higher Low. However, ADX at 24.9 is in the early stages of trend formation, making directional confirmation premature. Weekly RSI at 46.9 sits at the lower end of neutral. 4-hour RSI at 36.9, similar to daily, is in oversold territory. This is a rebound attempt after five consecutive days of decline.
